done_when: When close's merge of the default branch leaves the branch's own changes (its diff against the merge base) unchanged, the last review and its dismissals still count, and --dismiss given in the same command applies to that review; any change to the branch's own diff still needs a new review. New and existing repos: same behaviour in any repo on this release. One command-level test: review, dismiss, main moves, close merges it and the dismissal still holds without a new review.
why: After forge close merges the latest default branch, a review and the coordinator's dismissals stop counting even when the branch's own changes are unchanged, so a full review runs again and raises the same findings
